lead_intro: Learn about the first FIFA World Cup hosted in Uruguay in 1930 and the interesting dynamics surrounding the event.

quiz.question: Which two countries played in the final match of the first FIFA World Cup in 1930?
quiz.explanation: The final match of the first FIFA World Cup in 1930 was played between Uruguay and Argentina, with Uruguay winning 4-2.

quiz.question: Why did only four European countries agree to participate in the first World Cup in Uruguay?
quiz.explanation: Only four European countries agreed to participate in the first World Cup in Uruguay due to little interest in the event, especially because of the long two-week ship journey to reach Uruguay.

quiz.question: How was the issue of finding a referee for the final match resolved?
choices: Found only a few hours before the match
quiz.answer: Found only a few hours before the match
quiz.explanation: The issue of finding a referee for the final match was resolved by finding one only a few hours before the match, as the rivalry between Uruguay and Argentina made it challenging to agree on a referee.

quiz.question: How was the FIFA World Cup host determined for the first event in 1930?
choices: Uruguay was chosen after winning the Olympic Games
quiz.answer: Uruguay was chosen after winning the Olympic Games
quiz.explanation: Uruguay was chosen to host the first FIFA World Cup in 1930 after their victory at the Olympic Games, as part of the Centenary celebrations of the country's Independence.

quiz.question: What was unique about the football used in the final match between Uruguay and Argentina?
choices: Each team used their own ball
A special gold-plated ball was used
quiz.answer: Each team used their own ball
quiz.explanation: In the final match between Uruguay and Argentina, each team used their own ball - one half was played with the Argentine ball and the other half with the Uruguayan ball.
